mapper.select: select file_object_id fileObjectId,logical_name logicalName,current_version_no currentVersionNo,next_version_no nextVersionNo,status,created_by createdBy,version from file_object where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId}
mapper.update: update file_object set next_version_no=next_version_no+1,version=version+1,update_time=sysdate() where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} and next_version_no=#{expectedNextVersion} and version=#{expectedVersion} and status in ('PENDING','ACTIVE')

update file_object set current_version_no=greatest(current_version_no,#{versionNo}),status='ACTIVE',version=version+1,update_time=sysdate() where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} and status in ('PENDING','ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select v.file_version_id fileVersionId,v.file_object_id fileObjectId,v.version_no versionNo,v.object_key objectKey,v.original_file_name originalFileName,v.content_type contentType,v.size_bytes sizeBytes,v.sha256,v.created_by createdBy,v.create_time createdAt from file_object o join file_object_version v on v.file_object_id=o.file_object_id and v.version_no=o.current_version_no where o.file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} and o.status='ACTIVE'

select file_version_id fileVersionId,file_object_id fileObjectId,version_no versionNo,object_key objectKey,original_file_name originalFileName,content_type contentType,size_bytes sizeBytes,sha256,created_by createdBy,create_time createdAt from file_object_version where file_version_id=#{fileVersionId}

select file_version_id fileVersionId,file_object_id fileObjectId,version_no versionNo,object_key objectKey,original_file_name originalFileName,content_type contentType,size_bytes sizeBytes,sha256,created_by createdBy,create_time createdAt from file_object_version where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} order by version_no desc

select upload_intent_id uploadIntentId,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,file_object_id fileObjectId,target_version_no targetVersionNo,object_key objectKey,original_file_name originalFileName,content_type contentType,expected_size expectedSize,expected_sha256 expectedSha256,request_fingerprint requestFingerprint,actor_id actorId,status,completed_version_id completedVersionId from file_upload_intent where actor_id=#{actorId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select upload_intent_id uploadIntentId,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,file_object_id fileObjectId,target_version_no targetVersionNo,object_key objectKey,original_file_name originalFileName,content_type contentType,expected_size expectedSize,expected_sha256 expectedSha256,request_fingerprint requestFingerprint,actor_id actorId,status,completed_version_id completedVersionId from file_upload_intent where upload_intent_id=#{uploadIntentId} for update
mapper.update: update file_upload_intent set status='COMPLETED',completed_version_id=#{versionId},completed_at=sysdate() where upload_intent_id=#{uploadIntentId} and status='REGISTERED'
mapper.select: select relation_id relationId,action_id actionId,file_object_id fileObjectId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId,material_type materialType,visibility,created_by createdBy,created_dept_id createdDeptId,active from file_business_relation where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} and active=1

select relation_id relationId,action_id actionId,file_object_id fileObjectId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId,material_type materialType,visibility,created_by createdBy,created_dept_id createdDeptId,active from file_business_relation where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} and business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and material_type=#{materialType} and visibility=#{visibility} and active=1 limit 1

select relation_id relationId,action_id actionId,file_object_id fileObjectId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId,material_type materialType,visibility,created_by createdBy,created_dept_id createdDeptId,active from file_business_relation where created_by=#{actorId} and action_id=#{actionId} limit 1

select distinct r.file_object_id fileObjectId,r.material_type materialType from file_business_relation r join file_object o on o.file_object_id=r.file_object_id and o.status='ACTIVE' where r.business_type=#{businessType} and r.business_id=#{businessId} and r.active=1 and r.file_object_id in #{id}

select access_token_id accessTokenId,file_object_id fileObjectId,file_version_id fileVersionId,access_type accessType,token_hash tokenHash,actor_id actorId,actor_dept_id actorDeptId,expires_at expiresAt,consumed_at consumedAt from file_access_token where token_hash=#{tokenHash} for update
mapper.update: update file_access_token set consumed_at=#{consumedAt} where access_token_id=#{accessTokenId} and consumed_at is null and expires_at>#{consumedAt}
mapper.select: select access_log_id accessLogId,file_object_id fileObjectId,file_version_id fileVersionId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId,access_type accessType,actor_id actorId,actor_dept_id actorDeptId,client_ip clientIp,accessed_at accessedAt from file_access_log where file_object_id=#{fileObjectId} order by accessed_at desc,access_log_id desc
